title: Change disposition
purpose: Record a new receipt decision after client response or laboratory review, preserving the previous decision and its reason.

items.label: Current / Client / Project
items.description: Current receipt disposition and the sample’s order ownership.

sections.title: Fields and actions
paragraphs: Physically disposed samples cannot change disposition. A concurrent sample/custody/retention change is refused; reload and review history before resubmitting. Prior decisions remain in history. Hold and Reject can block downstream work; a receipt Hold also blocks physical disposal. This form changes the decision, not the underlying observations.

items.label: Disposition
items.description: Required Proceed, Qualify, Hold or Reject. Choose a different value from the current disposition.

items.label: Client response / reason
items.description: Required explanation; it becomes the current disposition note and stays in attributed change history.

items.label: Change disposition
items.description: Custodians, project managers and administrators save and return to the sample.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the sample without changing the decision.
